Programa de voluntariado corporativo da: MAPFRE's corporate volunteering program, with a structured group track, connects employees to NGOs pre-vetted by Studio FH to solve real challenges faced by social organizations — end to end and 100% remote. Over three annual editions, the program mobilized 167 employees, supported 30 NGOs in more than 30 cities and reached more than 186,000 people.
Estruturar um programa que fosse além de: Building a program that went beyond donation drives and one-day volunteer events to create real, measurable and ongoing impact.

Organizações sociais enfrentam problemas: Social organizations face management, technology and communication problems they can't solve on their own.
As ONGs não têm recursos para contratar: NGOs can't afford to hire specialists — and the knowledge they need exists inside companies.

“Faltava uma ponte estruturada entre o c: “There was no structured bridge between the technical knowledge of MAPFRE employees and the real needs of these organizations.”
O Studio FH arquitetou o programa de pon: Studio FH designed the program end to end: it created the skills-based volunteering model, set the criteria for nationwide vetting of NGOs aligned with MAPFRE's guidelines and structured how groups were formed, mixing skill profiles and seniority levels to maximize the quality of the deliverables — avoiding a single hierarchy level per group.
Sobre essa arquitetura, operou cada etap: On top of this architecture, Studio FH ran every stage of the journey:
Seleção de organizações com causas adere: Selecting organizations across Brazil whose causes align with MAPFRE's guidelines.
Mapeamento do desafio real de cada organ: Mapping each organization's real challenge before forming the groups.
Organização das inscrições dos colaborad: Managing employee sign-ups and building teams by skills and seniority.
Condução dos alinhamentos entre voluntár: Running alignment meetings between volunteers and NGO leaders and following the 100% remote execution via Teams/Meet.
Apoio para transformar o trabalho dos gr: Helping turn the groups' work into ready-to-use solutions for the NGOs.

A ONG roda uma carreta pelo Brasil ofere: The NGO drives a mobile unit across Brazil offering mammograms to vulnerable women. Duplicate records were causing patients to lose their own exam appointments — in a cause where early diagnosis is a matter of life and death.
Um grupo de voluntários MAPFRE, com apoi: A group of MAPFRE volunteers, supported by the technology team, diagnosed the registration flow and implemented an automation that eliminated the duplicates — solved in a few hours, at no cost to the NGO.
A própria organização registrou “avanços: The organization itself reported “concrete progress, at both the strategic and operational level” in the fight against breast cancer. A simple fix now protects exam access for thousands of women.
Acolhendo crianças e adolescentes em vul: Caring for vulnerable children and teenagers, the NGO had no LGPD (data protection) compliance structure at all — which undermined its legal certainty and its eligibility for grants and public funding.
Uma voluntária especialista em proteção: A volunteer specializing in data protection created, from scratch, a data subject rights request form, a personal data deletion system and a consent template for outings with the children.
A ONG saiu de exposição jurídica para co: The NGO went from legal exposure to full documentation compliance, unlocking fundraising and institutional partnerships.
em consultoria que a organização não ter: in consulting the organization couldn't have afforded.
Fundada para acolher filhos de trabalhad: Founded to care for the children of rural workers and now responsible for babies and children aged 0 to 6, the organization grew without ever formalizing an HR function — no workplace climate survey and no standardized processes.
O grupo de voluntários, com um workshop: With a workshop led by MAPFRE's own people management specialists, the volunteer group delivered a workplace climate survey, operational management spreadsheets, an HR policy guide and standardized processes.
Pela primeira vez a ONG passou a ter uma: For the first time, the NGO has a professional HR structure, reducing its reliance on informal knowledge and giving its leadership tools that organizations of this size rarely manage to build on their own.
A parceria entre a MAPFRE e o Studio FH: The partnership between MAPFRE and Studio FH showed that corporate volunteering can be both people development and a professional solution for the nonprofit sector. With a skills-based model, nationwide vetting and 100% remote operations, 167 employees produced more than 100 deliverables for 30 NGOs, reaching more than 186,000 people and saving the organizations more than R$317K — with unanimous approval from the NGOs served in the latest edition.
O programa segue como trilha estruturada: The program continues as a structured MAPFRE initiative, with new cycles, new organizations and the same principle: the knowledge that already exists inside the company, put at the service of those who need it most.
